name: mixed-chat-providers
description: Worked example for spec Success Criterion #1 (mixed-provider workflow runs end-to-end): a linear chain of three tool-suppressed chat (llm_call) nodes, each bound to a DIFFERENT provider via its own profile alias — a local-Ollama drafter, an Anthropic-API reviewer, and an OpenAI summarizer. Nodes reference only profile aliases, so the same graph runs by repointing the alias bindings. The chain terminates in a transform so the walk ends cleanly.
author: arbitron

inputs.name: topic
inputs.description: The subject the drafter drafts, the reviewer reviews, and the summarizer summarizes.

nodes.label: Drafter (local Ollama chat)
nodes.description: Drafts the topic using a keyless local-Ollama chat backend.

nodes.label: Reviewer (Anthropic API chat)
nodes.description: Reviews the draft using a keyed Anthropic Messages-API chat backend.

nodes.label: Summarizer (OpenAI chat)
nodes.description: Summarizes the review using a keyed OpenAI-compatible chat backend.

nodes.label: Done (terminal)
nodes.description: Terminal node with no outgoing edges. Records the final status so the walk ends cleanly.
